card.line: The Valley of Aijalon was a valley in land first given to Dan, where Joshua asked God to make the moon stand still.

moments.title: The moon stands still
moments.text: On the day the LORD gave the Amorites over to Israel, Joshua asked the sun to stand still over Gibeon and the moon over the Valley of Aijalon. The sun and moon stopped until the nation took vengeance on its enemies, because the LORD fought for Israel.
